# id: PG-pg-84-balance-medic
# covers: PG 191 (Section L balance sweep, generated by tools/balance_driver.py gen; edit the generator, not this file)
# fixture: Testing-Save-Full-Base (squad Avarek + Beaks)
# reset: fresh
# needs: ProfessionGearProgression.dll 36D7474D+ (pg_statprobe), harness c5a5c88+ (give artifacts, research start any; 90a0e33: teleport moved=/bed, speed hold; 6933d0f: fill topup, drop all; 616121b: benches near; c4fa520: pin, d91fe88: face) (KAH 24: chance, detect, detecttime, healtime, findwater, swimtime, construct, construction); client kah.py from the harness repo (LONG_COMMANDS has the KAH 24 timers); set_test_mode.ps1 -Mode Forced -Rules InGameTest
# design: Beaks (medic, 5 Basic First Aid Kits) treats Avarek: per point healtime ... wound 30 gives Avarek full
#   health, no bandages and the same three cuts, then times the first aid at speed 1. Avarek is NOT
#   protected while treated (protect heals wounds). Result = bandaging added per game second.
# verify: finished=1 in every point; own50 > none = first aid reads the hooked Medic.
#   Data: python3 tools/balance_driver.py csv <out> > balance.csv; python3 tools/analyze_balance.py balance.csv
@wait-world
@sleep 8
speed 0
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 4
speed 0
protect Avarek on
protect Beaks on
health Beaks 100
health Avarek 100
blood Beaks 100%
blood Avarek 100%
hunger Beaks 280
hunger Avarek 280
select Beaks
clearjobs Beaks
pg_statprobe on Beaks
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks Avarek dist 4 ~ moved=1
protect Avarek off
drop Avarek "Basic First Aid Kit" all
drop Avarek "Standard First Aid Kit" all
drop Beaks "Basic First Aid Kit" all
drop Beaks "Standard First Aid Kit" all
inv Avarek ~ ^(?!.*First Aid Kit)
inv Beaks ~ ^(?!.*First Aid Kit)
speed 1 hold
!healtime Beaks Avarek wound 30 timeout 60 ~ finished=0 .*bandaging 0\.0+ -> 0\.0+
speed 0
@echo BAL2,191,medic,0,0,nokit,w0,heal_control,0,bandaging 0 -> 0,-
pg_statprobe read
give Beaks "Basic First Aid Kit" 5
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks Avarek dist 4 ~ moved=1
give Beaks "Iron Hat" 1
equip Beaks "Iron Hat"
pg_info Beaks "Iron Hat" ~ equipped=1
# --- d1 diagnostic: skill 10, wound 60, Basic kit only ---
setstat Beaks medic 10
drop Beaks "Basic First Aid Kit" all
drop Beaks "Standard First Aid Kit" all
give Beaks "Basic First Aid Kit" 1
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks Avarek dist 4 ~ moved=1
@echo READY
where Beaks ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
inv Beaks ~ Basic First Aid Kit
speed 1 hold
stat Beaks medic ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set H healtime Beaks Avarek wound 60 timeout 600 ~ (seconds_bandaging=[\d.]+ bandaging [\d.]+ -> [\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,191,medic_diag_basic_cut60,10,0,none,d1,heal,0,${H},-
pg_statprobe read
hunger Beaks 280
# --- d2 diagnostic: skill 90, wound 60, Basic kit only ---
setstat Beaks medic 90
drop Beaks "Basic First Aid Kit" all
drop Beaks "Standard First Aid Kit" all
give Beaks "Basic First Aid Kit" 1
wake Beaks
speed 1 hold
@sleep 3
speed 0
@until 30 teleport Beaks Avarek dist 4 ~ moved=1
@echo READY
where Beaks ~ ^(?!.*\b(KO|DEAD)\b)
inv Beaks ~ Basic First Aid Kit
speed 1 hold
stat Beaks medic ~ wounds=1\.0000
@set H healtime Beaks Avarek wound 60 timeout 600 ~ (seconds_bandaging=[\d.]+ bandaging [\d.]+ -> [\d.]+)
speed 0
@echo BAL2,191,medic_diag_basic_cut60,90,0,none,d2,heal,0,${H},-
pg_statprobe read
hunger Beaks 280
# --- d3 diagnostic: skill 90, wound 30, Standard kit only ---
setstat Beaks medic 90
